title: Mack opens in the basement
intro: Opening week went six days and nobody needed all of them. Matt W put up the top score, went 9-0 against the whole league and beat Mack by 599, the biggest margin of the young season. Max rode 335.5 from Tyrese Maxey, Luka dropped 150.5 on Sunday for Karan and Karan still lost by 358.5, and Sammy won a matchup with the seventh best score in the league.

teams.Matt W: Top score, a perfect lineup every day and the most starter games in the league. Jaylen Brown, Giannis and Karl-Anthony Towns combined for 715, which is the kind of week you frame. The one blemish is Jared McCain, who turned two starts into 14.5 points. Next up is Koren, who has beaten him three times in twenty tries.
teams.Ben: Second best score in the league and a win over Koren by 91.5. Haliburton, Sengun and Reaves all cleared 215, and Ben was busy on the wire, adding Andre Drummond, Derrick Jones Jr. and Ayo Dosunmu while streaming Moussa Diabate and Egor Demin. Keep an eye on that Dosunmu move.
teams.Max: The four-time champ picked up where he left off. Tyrese Maxey was the player of the week with 335.5 over four games, and Kyshawn George paid off right away as a pickup with 97.5. Jalen Green gave him 56.5 in two starts, which is a problem for another week. Karan got buried by 358.5.
teams.Dean: Dean made zero moves and won anyway. Domantas Sabonis had 276.5 and Ty Jerome, of all people, had 275, nearly matching him. Keegan Murray's 49 in three games is the only thing to complain about. Beat Matt G by 87.5 for a 1-0 start.
teams.Koren: The heartbreaker of the week. Koren had the fourth best score in the league and the best single day of anyone, 654.5 on Friday, and still lost to Ben by 91.5. Embiid looked healthy with 245 in three games. Next week is Matt W, a matchup that has gone badly for Koren historically.
teams.Sammy: The luckiest win of the week. Sammy scored 1,891.5, seventh in the league, and beat Sean by 39.5 because Sean was eighth. Jalen Johnson carried with 280.5 and Wendell Carter Jr. added 107.5 off the wire. Cam Johnson got picked up and returned 17 points in two games. Max is next.
teams.Matt G: SGA and Amen Thompson combined for 490 and it was not enough. Matt G lost to Dean by 87.5 with the sixth best score, which would have beaten four other teams. Andrew Wiggins had 88.5 in three starts. Ben is next, and Matt G owns that series.
teams.Sean: Lost the closest game of the week by 39.5. Wemby, Trae and rookie Cameron Boozer all cleared 200, and Julian Champagnie gave him 127 as a pickup. The anchor was Nikola Vucevic, who put up 38 points in three games. That is 12.7 a night from a starter.
teams.Karan: Luka had the game of the week, 150.5 on Sunday, and Jalen Smith was the waiver hero with 160.5. Karan still finished ninth. The culprits: the fewest starter games in the league at 33, and Josh Giddey at 39.3 a game, the worst of any player drafted in the first three rounds.
teams.Mack: Rough start. Mack went 0-9 against the league and lost by 599, the biggest blowout of the week. Anthony Edwards had 233 and Pascal Siakam 183.5, but Donovan Mitchell only played twice and the best day all week was 401. Brook Lopez as a pickup was a bright spot with 101.

preview: Sammy and Max are both 1-0 and Max has owned this matchup for years. Matt W gets Koren after Koren's heartbreak, and Karan and Mack meet with both looking for their first win.
